mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, role_code, role_name, role_scope, status, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_role WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{roleId} AND role_scope='TENANT' AND deleted=0
SELECT rp.permission_id FROM sys_role_permission rp INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id=#{roleId}
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM sys_permission WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_role SET version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{roleId} AND role_scope='TENANT' AND deleted=0 AND status='ACTIVE' AND version=#{version}
